title: Real-Time Truck Tracking System
summary: Real-time dispatch and truck route tracking platform monitoring 10-20 transport units daily across 4 industrial checkpoints.
details: Engineered at PT Sumatera Prima Fiberboard with a 2-3 person team to enhance physical logistics visibility across factory gates, track 10-20 trucks daily across 4 checkpoints, and eliminate transport haulage bottlenecks.

title: ALC Learning — Learning Management System
summary: Full-stack Learning Management System supporting academic assessments, daily exercises, and grade tracking for 600+ active students.
details: Deployed in production at Alpha Omega Learning Center with role-based access control, grade book analytics, and modular exercise distribution for over 600 students. Accompanied by a financial cash flow program detecting IDR 19M in audit discrepancies.

title: PT. Dagangan Karya Indonesia Analysis Project
summary: Commercial retail data analytics, customer cohort modeling, and business intelligence reporting for PT. Dagangan Karya Indonesia.
details: Conducted end-to-end commercial transactional analytics, exploratory data cleansing, and Tableau KPI dashboards evaluating rural retail distribution for PT. Dagangan Karya Indonesia; co-authored research paper awarded Third Best Presentation Team at Bitlabs MSIB Batch 7.
